outputs: Tool calls with parameter assignments to fulfill user queries
Generated responses with correct tool selection and API call formatting
Text responses with tool selections and API calls for fulfilling user queries

The model generates tool calls with correct parameters and sequences to fulfill user queries, including selecting appropriate tools, assigning correct parameter names and values, and formatting API calls correctly.

changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant tasks (Tool Use and Function Calling are already covered by Tool Use Generation), removed duplicate dataset (BFCL), removed models only used as baselines not evaluated, simplified outputs to core NLG aspects
Consolidated all accuracy variants under 'Accuracy' metric. Removed dataset-specific categories (Non-live, Live, etc.) as they are evaluation scenarios, not separate metrics.
Removed all metadata as the paper uses self-evaluation only for MCTS internal reward calculation during training, not for post-generation evaluation. No LLM-as-judge methodology is employed.
No human evaluation conducted in the paper. All evaluation is done using automatic metrics on benchmark datasets.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on tool use generation using iterative reinforced fine-tuning. Evaluation is primarily automatic using accuracy metrics on tool-use benchmarks. The self-evaluation mentioned is for internal MCTS reward calculation, not for LLM-as-judge evaluation.
